title: Grateful Dead Live at Carousel Ballroom on 1968-03-31
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.03 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Fair audience recording with early sound issues, but captures a high‑octane 1968 Dead appetizer.
ai_review.review: The short sample of this March ’68 show is described as a high‑energy party set that feels like an appetizer to the band’s more extensive performances. Recording quality starts out very weak – the first two tracks are muffled and low‑volume – then improves noticeably, though it never reaches hi‑fi soundboard standards. Overall listeners get a glimpse of the era’s raw excitement despite the technical shortcomings.

ai_rating.rationale: Mixed feedback: one positive 4‑star review praises the show’s energy, a 3‑star neutral note adds little detail, and a 0‑star comment highlights serious recording problems. Limited data leads to a moderate rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: First two songs are very quiet and muffled, like listening in a hallway with no speakers; later tracks gain clarity but overall remain below soundboard quality.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Described as a high‑octane, party‑like appetizer; short but lively set that captures the 1968 Dead vibe.
